workload.name: Runner hardware
workload.description: CPU (sysbench, 7-Zip, PassMark), memory bandwidth, disk (fio in the job workspace), network downloads, a docker pull, and pgbench against a PostgreSQL service container.

runners.label: ubuntu-24.04
runners.note: Standard 4 vCPU runner GitHub gives public repositories.

runners.label: github24-2cpu-x64
runners.note: GitHub 2-core larger runner (the size private repositories get as standard).

suiteNotes.node: 8 GB is not enough for the opencode typecheck, even with turbo limited to 4 tasks: TypeScript processes are killed out of memory (exit 137). 16 GB passes.

runners.note: Same AMD Turin CPU as runson-m8a-x64 with twice the RAM; /tmp, /home/runner and /var/lib/docker live in memory (extras=tmpfs).

suiteNotes.docker: With tmpfs, /var/lib/docker lives in RAM: a PostHog image build outgrows the 32 GB this machine shares between the tmpfs and the build itself, and the runner runs out of memory. r8a.2xlarge (64 GB) has the room.

suiteSkips.docker: Not run: needs more than 32 GB of RAM with tmpfs, where Docker's data root lives in RAM; PostHog's layers plus the build's own memory exceeded it and the runner was shut down mid-build. The 64 GB tmpfs runner builds it.
